name: Stuffed roasted chiles
intro: Charred poblanos, stuffed and baked in a simple tomato broth. Picadillo on a weeknight, jack cheese when there's no meat.

proteins.name: Ground beef
proteins.timing: Browned 6–8 minutes, then cooked down with apple, onion, and chile.

proteins.name: Monterey jack
proteins.timing: No meat. Tucked into each chile.

needs: ¼ white onion, plus a little more for the picadillo

steps.text: Char the poblanos on a burner or under the broiler until black all over. Cover them in a bowl for 15 minutes, then peel. Slit each down one side and pull out the seeds.
Heat the oven. Blend the tomatoes with the onion, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Picadillo: brown the beef hard, then add a little diced onion, the apple, one chopped strip of chile, salt, and a few spoonfuls of the blended tomato. Cook until thick.
Stuff each chile with picadillo or cheese. Pour the rest of the tomato into a baking dish and set the chiles in it.
Bake until the filling is hot and the cheese gives.
Your flavor, cilantro, and lime at the table.

leftovers: One chile and its sauce is tomorrow's lunch. It reheats well.
